### How to Buy
All pieces are sold directly from my studio. To claim a piece, email lisa@lisamayceramics.com with the item you’d like, and we’ll coordinate payment (e.g. Venmo) and shipping.  

Available pieces are updated as soon as they’re claimed. If something you love is already sold, let me know—I’m happy to make another in the same spirit.
